comments.value: give the mute som sing language xD as emots
Adding the ability to message other users that are in and not in your current world in combination with this would be a great idea.
@{5d5f5918fc6cf50f113fd38b|full_name}: I agree.
This would be such a simple and useful solution to add. Let's make it happen!
@{5d60f20b86c60e2377e2049e|full_name}: Yes!
@{5d5f4a08ecd2d60ee45f5803|full_name}: I do believe that there are websites for animations you can download to put as emotes.
That, and fix IK so it's easier to speak sign language.
Yes please! More functional emojis! We like the ones that are fun too but there is untapped potential here that can be used for signalling as well.
@{5bb0cf554006de107a183831|full_name}: Yes!!! ♥
@{5ae14b192f26cf1a6d66ba79|full_name}: Thank you!!! ♥
Great idea also add I would love to be able to upload our own emojis. That way you can add other expressions etc.
@{5bb0cf554006de107a183831|full_name}: this please!
@{5a6600a092b3ff44cffeb382|full_name}: That sounds like a lovely feature but it would be tricky to keep people from abusing it.
@{5a6600a092b3ff44cffeb382|full_name}: then you might aswell add your own particle effects on your avatar meanwhile

@{5c86d86d87413d1fa2337849|full_name}:  I mean well yeah, but they could limit it to how the current emojis works and have it were you can only upload specific sized imagery, however as Lotus said I could see people abuse it at least in the way of lewd, and inappropriate imagery.

@{5a6600a092b3ff44cffeb382|full_name}: yeahh but people will still bypass size and stuff tbh, but its literally no difference to normal avatar particle effects other than its easier to use and you dont need to clutter it on one avatar. 
Its a good idea but doesnt really become what you want it to be
There already are emojis in the emoji tab in the menu
@{5d6d9decb117e147833da3b7|full_name}: Yes there are some emojis, but Lotus is referring to specialized ones for Mute and Deaf People. Like the ones in the link under the main post
@{5d5f04cc297e8704245bcd88|full_name}: Yes what Toster said, thank you!
Should do this. its a great thing for Deaf people to be able to talk to hearing if they don't know how to sign.
Not only emojis would be great, I would also suggest emote messaging. You type out a sentence and it pops out like an emote. The image is how it could be implemented on the VRChat menu
@{5cc8ef132dfd030ccc7c49c3|full_name}: That is a fantastic idea!!!!!!
@{5da642723067bf4a801371ce|full_name}: Yes, especially if there are no markers or keyboards in the room.
